capabilities.archival_reason: Repository or package returned HTTP 404/Not Found

tool_signatures.name: hey_bubble_up
tool_signatures.description: Schedule an email thread to bubble up (reappear) at a specific time. Returns {success, error?}. Reversible via hey_pop_bubble. Requires the thread

tool_signatures.name: hey_bubble_up_if_no_reply
tool_signatures.description: Schedule an email thread to bubble up ONLY if there

tool_signatures.name: hey_cache_status
tool_signatures.description: Get local cache statistics: message counts, cache age, and storage estimate. Read-only with no side effects. Pass

tool_signatures.name: hey_collection
tool_signatures.description: Add or remove an email thread from a collection. Returns {success, error?}. Reversible by calling again with the opposite action. Use hey_list_collections to discover collection IDs.

tool_signatures.name: hey_delete_draft
tool_signatures.description: Permanently delete a draft by ID. This does not move it to Trash — it is gone immediately, same as the trash icon in Hey

tool_signatures.name: hey_download_attachment
tool_signatures.description: Download a single attachment from an email and save it to disk. First call hey_read_email to get the attachments[] array with IDs, filenames, and sizes, then call this tool with the attachment_id to save the file. Returns {local_path, filename, size, mime}.

tool_signatures.name: hey_edit_draft
tool_signatures.description: Update an existing draft

tool_signatures.name: hey_forward
tool_signatures.description: Forward an existing email to new recipients immediately. The original thread remains unchanged. Returns {success, error?}. Use instead of hey_send_email when sharing existing content; use hey_reply for responding within a thread.

tool_signatures.name: hey_get_calendar_invite
tool_signatures.description: Extract and parse a calendar invite (.ics) from an email. First call hey_read_email — if calendar_invites[] is present, call this tool to get full details: title, start, end, location, attendees, organizer, description, and raw_ics. To save the .ics file to disk, use hey_download_attachment instead.

tool_signatures.name: hey_imbox_summary
tool_signatures.description: Get a complete Imbox summary including screener count, bubbled up emails, and new emails. Use this for a comprehensive view of the inbox state.

tool_signatures.name: hey_label
tool_signatures.description: Add or remove a label on an email thread. Returns {success, error?}. Reversible by calling again with the opposite action. Use hey_list_labels to discover available label IDs.

tool_signatures.name: hey_list_collection_emails
tool_signatures.description: List emails in a specific collection. Returns cached results unless force_refresh=true.

tool_signatures.name: hey_list_collections
tool_signatures.description: List all collections in Hey.com. Returns array of {id, name}. Use the id with hey_collection or hey_list_collection_emails.

tool_signatures.name: hey_list_emails
tool_signatures.description: List emails in a Hey.com folder/view. Returns cached results unless force_refresh=true. Each email includes id, topicId, postingId, entryId, from, subject, date, and unread status. For folder=sent, from is always

tool_signatures.name: hey_list_label_emails
tool_signatures.description: List emails with a specific label. Returns cached results unless force_refresh=true.

tool_signatures.name: hey_list_labels
tool_signatures.description: List all labels/folders in Hey.com. Returns array of {id, name}. Use the id with hey_label or hey_list_label_emails.

tool_signatures.name: hey_list_reply_later
tool_signatures.description: List emails currently in the Reply Later stack. Returns cached results (same shape as hey_list_emails) unless force_refresh=true. Use hey_remove_reply_later with the returned postingId to remove an item.

tool_signatures.name: hey_list_screener
tool_signatures.description: List senders waiting in the Screener for approval. Returns cached results (same shape as hey_list_emails, plus clearanceId) unless force_refresh=true. Use hey_screen_by_id with the returned clearanceId to approve or reject.

tool_signatures.name: hey_list_set_aside
tool_signatures.description: List emails currently in the Set Aside stack. Returns cached results (same shape as hey_list_emails) unless force_refresh=true. Use hey_unset_aside with the returned postingId to remove an item.

tool_signatures.name: hey_mark_seen
tool_signatures.description: Clear the orange

tool_signatures.name: hey_mark_unseen
tool_signatures.description: Mark a thread as unseen/unread to reset its read status. Returns {success, error?}. Reading the email via hey_read_email implicitly marks it as seen again. To clear the orange

tool_signatures.name: hey_move_to
tool_signatures.description: Move an email thread between Hey.com views: imbox, feed, or paper_trail. Returns {success, error?}. Use paper_trail for receipts/automated mail, feed for newsletters, imbox to restore. Reversible by moving to a different destination. Does not affect trash, spam, or screener — use hey_set_status or hey_screen for those.

tool_signatures.name: hey_pop_bubble
tool_signatures.description: Pop (dismiss) a bubbled-up email thread so it sinks back into the Imbox. The thread is not deleted — it just stops being pinned at the top. Returns {success, error?}. Requires the thread

tool_signatures.name: hey_read_email
tool_signatures.description: Read an email thread

tool_signatures.name: hey_read_status
tool_signatures.description: Set the read/unread status of an email entry. Returns {success, error?}. Reversible by calling again with the opposite status. Operates on individual entries (use entryId), not whole threads. For marking an entire thread as unseen, use hey_mark_unseen instead.

tool_signatures.name: hey_remove_reply_later
tool_signatures.description: Remove an email from Reply Later, marking it

tool_signatures.name: hey_reply
tool_signatures.description: Reply to an email thread, preserving threading on both ends. Returns {success, error?}. By default the reply goes to the other thread participants (your own address is automatically excluded); pass

tool_signatures.name: hey_reply_later
tool_signatures.description: Move an email thread to Reply Later. Reversible via hey_remove_reply_later (requires postingId from hey_list_reply_later). Returns {success, error?}. Use for emails you intend to respond to but not right now — if no reply is planned, use hey_set_aside instead.

tool_signatures.name: hey_save_draft
tool_signatures.description: Save a new draft email without sending it. Creates an entry in Hey

tool_signatures.name: hey_screen
tool_signatures.description: Approve or reject a sender by email address. Approve: routes the sender

tool_signatures.name: hey_screen_by_id
tool_signatures.description: Approve or reject a first-time sender from the Screener by clearance ID. Approve: allows future emails from this sender into the chosen destination (defaults to imbox). Reject: blocks future emails from this sender via the screener. Reversible from the Hey UI

tool_signatures.name: hey_search
tool_signatures.description: Search emails by query. Uses local FTS cache first, then network. Use force_refresh for real-time results.

tool_signatures.name: hey_send_email
tool_signatures.description: Send a new email immediately (no draft stage). Returns {success, error?}. Use for standalone outbound messages; use hey_reply for thread responses, or hey_forward to share existing emails with new recipients.

tool_signatures.name: hey_set_aside
tool_signatures.description: Move an email thread to Set Aside for later. Reversible via hey_unset_aside (requires postingId from hey_list_set_aside). Returns {success, error?}. Use for emails you plan to revisit but don

tool_signatures.name: hey_set_status
tool_signatures.description: Change an email thread

tool_signatures.name: hey_thread_mute
tool_signatures.description: Mute or unmute a thread (called

tool_signatures.name: hey_unset_aside
tool_signatures.description: Remove an email from Set Aside, moving it back to the Imbox or its original location. Returns {success, error?}. Requires the posting_id from hey_list_set_aside. Reversible by calling hey_set_aside again with the thread
